items.title: Propose, Don't Judge: An Anytime-Valid Referee for LLM Agents That Mine Investment Factors
items.claim: Frozen referees outperform leaky referees at controlling spurious factors.

items.title: The Price of Thought: Does Test-Time Reasoning Pay in LLM Trading?
items.claim: LLM test-time reasoning changes trading decisions without reliably improving returns.

items.title: What Analysts Miss: Predicting Consensus Forecast Errors from Earnings Calls
items.claim: Analyst forecast errors are predictable from earnings-call language and profitable to trade around announcements.

items.title: The Externality of Learning: Adaptive AI and Market Resilience
items.claim: Shared learning histories improve market resilience when policies are learned via locality-sensitive algorithms.

items.title: An Auditable Public-Data U.S. Equity Research Pipeline: Point-in-Time Factors, Asset Pricing, Portfolio Construction, and Walk-Forward Machine Learning
items.claim: Higher R-squared in multifactor models doesn't translate to stable after-cost portfolio outperformance.

items.title: DefaultGNN: A Dual-Perspective GNN Framework for Predicting Corporate Default from Buyer-Seller Transaction Networks
items.claim: Buyer-seller transaction networks predict default better than financial data for information-sparse firms.
